job_description:
**Job Description :**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

  

Our Digital and Technology (D&T) team are innovators, delivering ground-breaking solutions that will help shape the future of our iconic brands. Technology touches every part of our business, from the sourcing of sustainable ingredients to marketing and development of our online platforms. We utilise data insights to build competitive advantage, supporting our people to deliver value faster.

Our D&T team includes some of the most talented digital professionals in the industry. Every day, we come together to push boundaries and innovate, shaping the digital solutions of tomorrow. Whatever your passion, we’ll help you become the best you can be, creating career-defining work and delivering breakthrough thinking.

**About the role:**

Lead the engineering capability required to build and evolve reliable Commercial data solutions using reusable patterns, automated controls and product-aligned delivery. The role is accountable for engineering quality, delivery discipline and technical outcomes; product priorities and business value remain with product owners.

**Core skills required on a broader prospective -**

Years of exp - 3 to 10 years

  

Below technical capabilities the Analytical Product Manager/Owner need to possess the areas marked as #1 is non-negotiable in context of requirements:

Data & Analytics Foundations (#1)

* SQL proficiency for querying, validating and exploring data
* Understanding of data modelling (star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling)
* Familiarity with KPI design, metric definitions and semantic layers
* Statistical literacy (A/B testing, significance, forecasting basics)

Data Platforms & Architecture ( Foundational understanding of aspects as part of Product/Solution Architecture and its implications)

* Knowledge of modern data stacks: cloud data warehouses and lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse/Fabric)
* Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
* Awareness of data integration from ERP/CRM sources (e.g. SAP, Salesforce, Workday)
* APIs and data exchange principles

BI & Visualisation (previous experience required as this is capabilities/capacity would be provided from BI Transformation & Self-Service pillar)

* Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik)
* Dashboard design and data storytelling best practice
* Self-service analytics enablement

Data Governance & Quality (#1)

* Data quality frameworks, lineage and cataloguing (Collibra, Informatica, Alation)
* Master data management principles
* Data privacy and regulatory awareness
* Access control and security models

Advanced Analytics & AI (#1)

* Understanding of machine learning lifecycle and MLOps concepts
* Ability to scope predictive and prescriptive use cases
* Awareness of GenAI applications in analytics

Product Management Tooling & Methods (#1)

* Agile/Scrum delivery and backlog management (Jira, Azure DevOps)
* Writing user stories, acceptance criteria and data requirements
* Product roadmapping, prioritisation frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW)
* Product usage analytics and adoption tracking

Business Translation & Thought Leadership (#1)

* Functional use case formulation: identifying, defining and shaping analytics use cases with business functions (e.g. Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial)
* Translating business problems into technical requirements (BRDs including NFRs)
* Thought leadership: shaping the analytics vision for functional analytics products, advocating data-driven decision-making in context of the process the product is supporting and bringing an informed view on industry trends and emerging capabilities to evolve the product offering
* Value measurement and benefits tracking for analytics products
* Stakeholder management across business, GBS Data Office and GBS Product experience Towers

ML or GenAI solutions

Data science

**Worker Type :**

Regular

**Primary Location:**

Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

**Additional Locations :**

**Job Posting Start Date :**

2026-11-19

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Advanced Tech Product Owner
job_description:
Honeywell is charging into the Industrial IoT revolution with the establishment of Honeywell Connected Buildings (HCB), building on our heritage of invention and deep, on-the-ground industry expertise. HCB is the leading industrial disruptor, building and connecting software solutions to streamline and centralize the assets, people and processes that help our customers make smarter, more accurate business decisions. Moving at the speed of software, we are creating, innovating and delivering solutions fast, challenging the way things have always been done, piloting new ways for all of us to work, and expecting our successes to set new standards for our customers and for Honeywell.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Business analysis in a complex and Cross-Functional Stakeholder environment

* Overall 6+ years of software development experience

* 4+ years’ experience in Agile development environments as a Product Owner/Business Analyst

* Knowledge of supervisory domain in HVAC

* Proficient in multiple Agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, design thinking, UX, and other frameworks

* Proven ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to solve, or lead the solving of, strategic problems of high complexity on a large scale

WE VALUE

* Expert stakeholder management and commercial acumen to link both business and technical functions across a broad portfolio / large stakeholder group

* Collaboration, respect, openness, continuous learning, and immense pride in doing good work.

* A collaborative, team-oriented approach and excitement about working on a multi-functional, global team with a passion for the development craft

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Consult with product stakeholders to understand business drivers and translate them into functional and non-functional requirements

* You will work with Product Managers to evaluate the product Roadmap to identify features for development and identify "definition of done" for each feature

* Lead robust, fast (through) inceptions (identify scope, value, solution and release plan) and Own prioritized actionable backlogs

* Manage scope and drive trade-off decisions in conjunction with external stakeholders while balancing business requirements with technical requirements

* Elicit, capture, analyze, refine and document business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and other technical documentation

* Research and analyze industry trends and benchmarking information as they apply to the HCE business model and domain area needs

* Dissect high-level information into details and communicate details in a manner understood by relevant audiences

* Attend standups, grooming meetings, estimation meetings, retrospectives and other key meetings for the scrum team

* Co-own Release Plans and communicate changes to stakeholders regularly

* Follow complete lifecycle of project benefit, including reporting back on adoption, business value and customer satisfaction post go-live

* Identify blockers that will impact timeline, scope, cost or other product variables and escalate to the appropriate stakeholders

* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager II - DAU Labs
job_description:
**About the Team**
------------------

Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.

We are building an immersive feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty.

The DAU Labs team focuses on building engaging discovery experiences, scaling content supply, and solving complex personalization and ranking problems to drive user engagement, daily active users (DAU), and long-term retention.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Product Manager II at DAU Labs, you will play a key role in building and scaling Meesho's content-led discovery experience. You will work on creating engaging and personalized product experiences that help millions of users discover relevant trends, products, and inspiration.

You will own key product problems across content discovery, personalization, user engagement, and conversion. Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Business teams, you will identify opportunities, drive product improvements, and deliver measurable impact on DAU growth and user retention.

### **What you will do**

* **Product Strategy & Ownership:** Own key product areas within the content discovery ecosystem, identify user and business problems, and define product roadmaps aligned with DAU growth objectives.
* **Discovery & Personalization:** Work on improving content discovery, feed relevance, recommendation systems, and personalization to deliver engaging experiences tailored to different user cohorts.
* **User Engagement & Growth:** Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, daily active usage, session frequency, and long-term retention through data-driven product initiatives.
* **Experimentation & Analytics:** Drive product experiments, A/B testing, and data analysis to identify growth opportunities, measure product performance, and continuously improve user experience.
* **Product Execution:** Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into product requirements and drive end-to-end execution.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Content, Category Marketing, Seller Experience, and other business teams to improve content quality, discovery, and content-to-commerce conversion.
* **0-to-1 Problem Solving:** Identify new opportunities, solve ambiguous product problems, and build scalable product solutions that create meaningful user and business impact

### **What you will need**

* **Experience:** Overall experience of 4+ years, with at least 4+ years of experience in Product Management in a tech-led company. Experience in B2C or consumer internet companies is preferred.
* **Product & Domain Expertise:** Experience working on consumer-facing products, content-led platforms, discovery experiences, recommendation systems, personalization, or engagement-focused products is preferred.
* **Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:** Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to solve complex and ambiguous problems related to user discovery, engagement, personalization, and product growth.
* **Execution Bias:** Strong bias for action and execution, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* **Data-Driven Mindset:** Ability to use data, user insights, and experimentation to identify opportunities, make product decisions, and measure outcomes.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Business teams to drive product initiatives end to end.
* **Mindset:** Strong passion for Problem First Solving (PFS), ownership, and building scalable products from 0 to 1.

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

title: Deputy IT Product Owner - SAP Production to Stock ( P2S)
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced SAP P2S Senior Consultant for the deputy IT PO role. The role will lead the P2S team and be responsible for delivering P2S continuous development business requirements for SAP R/3 & S4 HANA. It requires strong Production execution domain knowledge, proven experience in both SAP R/3 and S4 technologies, expertise in repetitive manufacturing, interfaces – SOAP, OData, Idoc, RFC. process.

**Roles & Responsibility :**

* You are leading a team of experienced IT consultants and developers and actively develop the team to work in an agile organization.
* Furthermore, you actively participate in the process design, keep focus on technical aspects, drive re-usability and the usage of SAP Standard.
* Cross-functional integration with SAP PP- WM/EWM, ePPDS, QM, SD.
* You will consult User Department and Governance Functions in all P2S related questions and align dependencies with adjoining process areas.
* You will conduct the Product Lifecycle Management for your process chain, incl. Design & Build, Rollout, Support & Maintenance.
* Additionally, you are an active part of the development team, identifying dependencies or constraints and prioritizing the backlog refinement
* Collaborating with other IT Product Development Teams and Chief Product Owners to identify synergies and drive standardization will be one of your tasks.
* You address cross-team prioritization conflicts and drive resolution with other Product Owners.

job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Gurugram, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Gurugram hub**
-------------------------------

Spanning 437,000 sq. ft., our campus in Gurugram features two state-of-the-art towers – 1A and 2A at the Candor TechSpace in Sector 21.

### **Key facts:**

* Surrounded by 28 acres
* Space for 4,100 colleagues
* Opened in 2010

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own key parts of our digital lending platform. You will

shape how customers discover, apply for and receive credit products.

You will work closely with engineering, design, risk, marketing and lending partners. The goal is to

build reliable, scalable products that grow the business and improve the customer experience.

**Key responsibilities**

Product strategy and roadmap

* Define the product vision and roadmap for your area, aligned with business goals.

* Prioritize features based on customer needs, data and business impact.

* Write clear PRDs and define success metrics for every launch.

Partner and platform integrations

* Own integrations with lending partners such as banks and NBFCs.

* Work with engineering to design APIs, data flows and verification systems.

* Ensure platform reliability through monitoring and alerting.

**Growth and optimization**

* Identify growth opportunities across the customer funnel.

* Run experiments and A/B tests to improve conversion and retention.

* Use data to optimize marketing spend and customer targeting.

**Platform improvement**

* Improve existing systems for speed, scalability and ease of experimentation.

* Reduce manual work through automation and internal tools.

Collaboration and leadership

* Lead cross-functional squads using Agile practices.

* Mentor junior product team members.

* Share progress and results with senior leadership.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Engineering or a related field.

* 4–6 years of total work experience, with at least 3 years in product management.

* Experience building products in fintech, lending, credit cards or consumer

marketplaces.

* A track record of launching products that delivered measurable business results.

* Experience working with engineering teams on APIs, integrations or platform systems.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.

**Required skills**

* Product Technical Analytics
* Roadmapping SQL Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* PRDs Python Tableau
* User research APIs Microsoft Clarity
* Funnel optimization Microservices Dashboarding and reporting
* Agile / Scrum Data pipelines A/B testing
* System design fundamentals
* Core competencies: ownership mindset, data-driven decision making, stakeholder management,
* partner management, and team leadership.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with both secured or unsecured loans and credit cards.

* Familiarity with KYC, digital verification and underwriting workflows in India.

* Experience modernizing legacy platforms.

* Experience managing or mentoring a small team.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
We’re looking for a **Product Manager** to join our **Product** team in Noida.

Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize on continuous professional growth, offering workshops and training. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries. We promote work-life balance with flexible hours and remote options, fostering a supportive and inclusive culture. Competitive salaries, health benefits, and various perks further enhance the work experience.

Looking ahead, we aim to expand our technological capabilities and market reach, investing in advanced technologies and expanding our service offerings. We plan to deepen our expertise in AI and machine learning, enhance our cloud services, and continue fostering a culture of innovation and excellence. Taazaa is committed to staying at the forefront of technology trends, ensuring it delivers impactful and transformative solutions for its clients.

We are seeking a **Product Manager** with extensive hands-on experience in full cycle of Product planning, stakeholder management, product management, market research along with expertise in Agile.

**What you’ll do**

* Responsible (together with the startup’s CEO/CTO) for defining, driving, and communicating the product vision, goals, outcomes, and roadmap across the startup to keep everyone coordinated and prevent any silos.
* Managing and overseeing the entire product discovery and delivery lifecycle from strategic planning through tactical execution. Work very closely with the Project Manager, so that schedule and delivery never spill from the planning.
* Identify and prioritize key product features, functions, and enhancements based on market research, customer feedback, and internal stakeholders' input.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to define requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer feedback analysis to validate product features and identify areas for improvement.
* Partner with customer success to identify and resolve customer issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage product backlog, prioritize tasks, and maintain the product backlog in JIRA or similar project management tools
* Continuously looking for ways to improve our way of working and collaborating with our other product managers to ensure we are always growing

**Your qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in product management for SaaS products.
* Strong understanding of agile methodologies and product development lifecycle.
* Experience with user research, market research, and data analysis.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present ideas and information clearly and effectively.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions.
* Experience with JIRA or similar project management tools.
* Passion for delivering excellent products and a desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Experience in B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software.
* Experience with design thinking methodologies.
* Focus on outcomes and quality of output
* Empathetic and team player
* Driven, hard work ethic showing commitment

**Behavioural:**

Here are five essential behavioural skills a Product Manager should possess:

* **Effective Communication:** Clearly and concisely convey ideas, requirements, and feedback to team members, stakeholders, and clients, fostering an environment of open dialogue and mutual understanding.
* **Leadership and Mentorship**: Inspire and guide the development team, providing support and encouragement, while promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* **Problem-Solving Attitude:** Approach challenges with a proactive mindset, quickly identifying issues and developing innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.
* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work well within a team, encouraging collaboration and valuing diverse perspectives to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality results.
* **Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

**What you’ll get in return…**

Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops and certifications, while enjoying a flexible work-life balance with remote options. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity and exposes you to diverse projects across various industries. We offer clear career advancement pathways, comprehensive health benefits, and perks like team-building activities.

**Who we are**

Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.

Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity

title: Product Manager - IT
job_description:
**Role:** Product Manager - IT
  
  
**About Us:** Scrubsy is India's #1 foam-based household cleaner – trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We're a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality, and we're building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:** We're looking for a Product Manager - IT to own the discovery, design, and delivery of internal tools and systems that make the business run more efficiently. This role sits between business teams and engineering identifying manual or inefficient processes, defining requirements, and driving internal products from concept through adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Identify manual, inefficient, or error-prone internal processes across teams and translate them into internal tool or automation opportunities
  
Own the product lifecycle for internal tools discovery, PRDs/requirement documents, prioritization, execution, and adoption tracking
  
Define Statements of Work (SOWs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and success metrics for internal tooling initiatives
  
Partner closely with teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and manage delivery timelines
  
Drive cross-functional alignment across stakeholders to scope and prioritize process-improvement projects
  
Track and report measurable impact of shipped tools
  
Manage risks, timelines, and resourcing for internal product initiatives; proactively flag scope or timeline changes to stakeholders
  
Continuously gather feedback and identify the next set of improvement opportunities
  
Maintain documentation, status reporting, and dashboards
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
Mandatory Requirement
  
  
4+ years of experience in Product Management or a closely related role
  
Proven track record of building or managing internal tools, automation, or process-
  
improvement initiatives with measurable business impact
  
Demonstrated experience writing PRDs, SOWs, or detailed requirement documents and driving them through to delivery
  
Strong cross-functional stakeholder management experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field
  
  
Additional Requirement
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, D2C, or consumer tech product management
  
Exposure to AI/ML-driven features
  
Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, SQL, Power BI/Google Analytics, or similar product/data tooling
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* Proactive – you spot inefficiencies before they become problems and solve them
* Ownership Driven – you take complete ownership of your products, from identifying the problems to driving execution and adoption
* Detail Oriented – you pay attention to the details that can make or break a product, process, or user experience
* Curious – you constantly ask Why, explore better ways of working, and look for opportunities to automate and improve

**. Skillset Required:** Product Management, Internal tools, Automation, Process improvement, Business impact measurement, PRD writing, Statement of Work (SOW) writing, Requirement documentation, Cross-functional stakeholder management, E-commerce product management, D2C product management, Consumer tech product management, AI/ML-driven features, JIRA, SQL, Power BI, Google Analytics, Data tooling, Proactive problem solving, Product ownership, Attention to detail, Process automation

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

 **Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-Components
job_description:
Job Description

Position: Product Manager-Components

Reporting: Global Technical Lead

Job Location: Mumbai

Grade Level: Management

Purpose:

Product Manager Components will be responsible for managing and developing lubricant additive components. The

role involves technical evaluation, product development, performance testing, troubleshooting and providing technical

support to customers, suppliers and internal business teams.

The position requires strong technical knowledge of lubricant additives chemistries, base oils, finished lubricants,

testing methodologies and industry standards, along with the ability to coordinate technical projects and ensure

successful product qualification.

Responsibilities:

Technical Product Development & Management

 Manage and develop lubricant additive components and formulations for various applications.

 Evaluate raw materials, base oils, additive packages and their compatibility.

 Identify opportunities for new product development and improvement of existing formulations.

 Conduct technical assessments of product performance and suitability for different applications.

 Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers for technical specifications and product improvements.

 Coordinate with external laboratories for product testing and evaluation.

 Review and interpret laboratory test reports and technical data.

 Ensure testing is conducted as per applicable ASTM, ISO and other international standards.

 Evaluate test results and recommend necessary formulation improvements.

 Monitor product quality, consistency and performance against specifications.

Customer Technical Support

 Provide technical assistance and solutions to customers as per lubricant application.

 Handle technical queries, product complaints and troubleshooting requirements.

 Conduct technical discussions and presentations with customers.

 Support customer product trials, field evaluations and product qualification.

 Coordinate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide appropriate technical

solutions.

Supplier & Vendor Coordination

 Coordinate with global additive manufacturers, component suppliers and technical partners.

 Obtain and evaluate technical data sheets (TDS), safety data sheets (SDS), certificates of analysis (COA) and

product specifications.

 Review new products and assess their technical suitability.

 Maintain technical communication with international suppliers and partners.

Technical Documentation & Compliance

 Prepare and maintain technical reports, product specifications and evaluation reports.

 Maintain product development records and technical documentation.

 Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and customer requirements.

 Support product qualification, technical audits and customer assessments.

 Maintain updated technical databases for products, components and formulations.

Team & Project Coordination

 Coordinate with internal technical, sales, operations and laboratory teams.

 Monitor technical projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines.

 Provide technical guidance and support to team members.

 Participate in customer meetings, technical conferences, exhibitions and industry events.

 Submit regular technical progress reports to management.

Qualifications & Experience required:

Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Technology, Lubricant

Technology or a related discipline. Additional qualifications or certifications in lubricant technology and additive

chemistry will be an advantage.

Level of experience: 8–12 years of relevant experience in the lubricant additives, lubricants, petroleum or specialty

chemicals industry.

Technical skills: Strong understanding of lubricant additive chemistry, base oils and finished lubricant formulations.

Product development, technical evaluation and performance testing. Understanding of engine oils, industrial lubricants,

greases and specialty lubricants. Knowledge of ASTM, API, ACEA and relevant international specifications. Knowledge of

tribology testing, good analytical skills. Technical writing, Proven customer focus.

Behavioural competencies: Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, good interpersonal skills, team

spirit, open mindedness, sense of creativity.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

 Successful completion of technical development and product qualification projects.

 Timely resolution of customer technical queries and complaints.

 Accuracy and quality of technical evaluations and reports.

 Successful coordination of laboratory testing and product validation.

 Development and improvement of lubricant additive components and formulations.

 Technical support provided to sales and business development teams.

 Effective supplier and customer technical coordination.

 Achievement of project milestones within agreed timelines.

Stakeholders

Internal: Global Technical Head / Director – Technical & Technology, Technical Team, Sales & Business Development

Team, Operations & Administration Team

External: Suppliers, customers, OEM, third party labs, Universities, consultants and industry partners

General Expectations

 Maintain confidentiality of company information, formulations and technical data.

 Demonstrate professional conduct in all internal and external communications.

 Take ownership of assigned technical responsibilities and projects.

 Maintain a customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.

 Be willing to travel domestically and internationally as per business requirements.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

role_title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

job_description:
**Full Time**

Job Code: P-69693

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

1 position

Expires on 23/11/2026

Required Experience

**2 - 6 Years**

Skills

**B2B,**

**OMS,**

**SAP**

+ 2 more

**Job Description**

At Purplle, we sell beauty and personal care brands across general trade (GT), modern trade (MT) and e-commerce. We
  
are building the sales and order management platform that every one of those channels depends on, from order to cash.
  
The core objective is simple: create real, measurable value for our sales, finance and supply chain teams by making every
  
order faster to place, easier to approve and more accurate to fulfil.
  
You will join as a Product Manager owning this platform end to end, from problem discovery through launch and
  
adoption.
  
This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.
  

* You will own the roadmap and backlog of the platform and its ERP integrations (such as SAP HANA), working with

engineering, finance, supply chain and sales teams.
  

* You will turn real channel complexity (credit limits, pricing, schemes, stock allocation, approvals, returns) into clear

product requirements.
  

* Your work will directly drive order accuracy, order-to-invoice turnaround, fewer manual approvals and cleaner

handling of sales returns and credit notes.
  
Key responsibilities
  

* End-to-End Ownership: Own the platform from discovery and PRDs through design collaboration, build oversight,

launch and adoption.
  

* Roadmap & Outcomes: Own the roadmap and backlog, prioritising by business impact across GT, MT and

e-commerce teams. Define what success looks like for every feature at kick-off and instrument for it: own outcomes,
  
not just output.
  

* Sales Cycle Ownership: Own the end-to-end flow from order capture through credit checks, approval, ERP posting,

invoicing and dispatch.
  

* Sales Returns: Own the sales return and credit note flow: return reasons (expiry, damage, short shelf life, wrong

delivery), approvals, and how returns reflect in the ERP and stock.
  

* Channel Needs: Understand how sales processes differ across GT, MT and e-commerce, and build products flexible

enough to serve each of them.
  

* ERP & Integrations: Work with ERP and integration teams on how orders, inventory, pricing and returns flow

between the ERP, the platform, other portals and third-party tools.
  

* Iterative Delivery: Run a disciplined delivery cadence with engineering: validate direction early, correct fast, and ship

surgically once something is approved.
  

* Discovery & Stakeholders: Talk to sales, finance and operations users to find gaps; turn ambiguous business

problems into build-ready PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  

* KPI Ownership: Own order accuracy, order-to-invoice and approval turnaround, order failure and rejection rates, and

sales return turnaround.
  

* Live Support & Access: Be the first line of support for live issues (triage, root cause, fix) and define role-based access

so each user sees only what they should.
  
What we are looking for
  

* 2-3 years of B2B product management experience, with genuine end-to-end ownership of a product area (not just

feature delivery), ideally on internal tools, order management or sales and supply chain operations platforms used by
  
multiple user groups.
  

* Strong understanding of how FMCG sales works across GT, MT and e-commerce, including how primary, secondary

and tertiary sales work in GT (company to distributor, distributor to retailer, retailer to consumer), plus credit limits,
  
schemes, MRP and pricing.
  

* Clear understanding of the full sales cycle: order, approval, invoicing, dispatch, and sales returns and credit notes.
* Basic understanding of ERP sales modules (such as SAP SD: sales orders, deliveries, billing, returns) and hands-on

experience with integrations between the ERP, internal portals and third-party tools.
  
  

* Systems thinking: comfortable reasoning about platforms with multiple integrated modules, dependencies and

stakeholders rather than isolated features.
  

* Strong PRD and user story writing: well-scoped, edge cases covered, precise acceptance criteria, and low-fidelity

wireframes.
  

* Hands-on delivery management: independently runs stand-ups and sprint ceremonies, keeps the JIRA backlog clean

and surfaces blockers the same day, and validates early and corrects fast.
  

* Working knowledge of SQL, and comfort reading order, failure and return data to find problems and measure impact.
* Strong stakeholder management: aligns sales, finance, tech and external partners, and pushes back on requirements

when needed.
  

* Very high ownership and clarity of thought: breaks a problem into small, actionable items and, once direction is

given, leads from the front to closure.
  

* Curiosity, bias toward action and openness to feedback.

Good to have
  

* Hands-on experience with an order management system (OMS), B2B order flows or a distributor management

system (DMS).
  

* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP HANA, and API-based integrations with external portals.
* Experience with credit limit, pricing and scheme, inventory, approval or returns workflows.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.

What you will gain
  

* True end-to-end ownership of a business-critical product, from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Hands-on experience building a high-volume, multi-user platform with complex system integrations.
* Direct visibility and working relationships with senior business and technology leaders.
* A clear growth path, with your scope expanding as your impact grows.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Principal Product Manager - Contracts
job_description:
Overview:

**About JAGGAER**

JAGGAER is a global provider of AI-powered procurement software for complex sourcing, supply and spend. More than 1,400 global enterprises across manufacturing, public sector, higher education and other industries use our platform to manage sourcing, contracts, invoicing, payments and supplier relationships in one place.

JAGGAER One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Our platform supports a supplier community of more than 13 million and manages $2.9 trillion in annual spend.

Behind the technology is a global team guided by our TEAM values: Transparency, Entrepreneurial Spirit, Accountability and Metrics-Driven Results.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com.

**Principal Product Manager - Contracts**

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

The Principal Product Manager - Contracts will be the senior individual-contributor product leader for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities. The role will own product discovery, strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional execution for experiences that connect procurement, legal, finance, business stakeholders, and suppliers across the contract lifecycle. This position exists to improve customer outcomes, accelerate innovation, and strengthen the role of contract data and AI-enabled insights across the Source-to-Pay platform.

Principal Responsibilities:

**Principal Responsibilities**
==============================

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities.
* Develop deep understanding of customer workflows across contract request, authoring, review, approval, negotiation, execution, repository, obligations, amendments, renewals, and analytics.
* Lead customer discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and validation to identify high-value problems and emerging opportunities.
* Translate validated needs into product outcomes, user journeys, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success indicators.
* Prioritize roadmap and backlog decisions using customer impact, strategic alignment, technical feasibility, risk, adoption potential, and commercial value.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, Security, AI & Data, and domain experts to guide solution design and predictable delivery.
* Drive integration and workflow alignment with Sourcing, Supplier Management, Supplier Intelligence, Procure-to-Pay, analytics, enterprise systems, and relevant technology partners.
* Identify responsible opportunities for AI-assisted contract work, document intelligence, risk insight, obligation visibility, and decision support.
* Facilitate scope decisions and alignment across senior stakeholders, clearly communicating trade-offs, dependencies, and roadmap rationale.
* Lead go-to-market readiness for new and enhanced capabilities through positioning input, enablement, demonstrations, release content, and customer-facing expertise.
* Measure product performance through adoption, usage, task completion, customer satisfaction, retention, and business-impact indicators.
* Act as a product-management role model by mentoring colleagues, improving product practices, and influencing cross-portfolio standards without requiring formal people-management authority.

**Success in this Position**
============================

* A clear, customer-validated Contracts strategy and roadmap is understood and supported across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.
* Priority capabilities improve usability, adoption, customer satisfaction, and the value customers obtain from contract data and workflows.
* Engineering teams receive clear product context, requirements, priorities, and timely decisions that support predictable delivery.
* The Contracts experience is well integrated with the broader Source-to-Pay platform and differentiated in customer and prospect conversations.

Position Requirements:

**Must Have**

* Typically 7+ years of product-management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, including end-to-end ownership of complex product capabilities.
* Strong domain experience in contract lifecycle management, procurement technology, legal technology, commercial contracting, or Source-to-Pay software.
* Practical understanding of enterprise contract workflows, user groups, governance needs, integrations, and adoption challenges.
* Demonstrated success leading discovery, setting strategy, prioritizing roadmaps, and launching enterprise software products.
* Strong knowledge of software development lifecycles, agile product delivery, UX collaboration, and effective partnership with Engineering.
* Analytical and metrics-driven approach to product decisions, including customer evidence, usage insights, and business outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels without formal authority.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across time zones and travel periodically for customer and internal meetings.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in legal operations, commercial contracting, procurement transformation, or enterprise content/document products.
* Experience with AI, natural-language processing, document intelligence, e-signature ecosystems, or contract-data integrations.
* Experience working across European and Indian product or engineering teams.

  **What We Offer:**

  At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

  **Our Values - T.E.A.M:**

  At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.

  + Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
  + Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
  + Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
  + Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

  **EEO:**

  JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  **Great Place to Work****® Certified 2026 – JAGGAER**

  Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.

  We are proud to announce that **JAGGAER has been certified as a** **Great Place to Work****® for 2026**, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high-performing culture.

title: Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Based Intelligence)
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Intelligence & Scoring)**  
  
  
**About the Product Team**  
  
The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travellers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
**About InsurTech and this role**  
  
The InsurTech Product team creates peace of mind so travellers can book and travel with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of InsurTech, FinTech, Data Science, and Platform Product Management, focusing on **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** .
  
  
Y

ou will help define and build the risk signals, predictive models, decisioning services, and scoring capabilities that power protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands. These capabilities will enable accurate risk assessment, pricing optimization, underwriting decisions, fraud and loss mitigation, and monetization strategies that account for inventory arbitrage, pricing volatility, and demand fluctuations.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business stakeholders, you will shape the foundational platforms, integrations, and operating models that allow our protection and financial products to scale globally, remain compliant across markets, and deliver sustainable business growth. Your success will come from simplifying complex systems, unlocking new platform capabilities, and using data-driven insights to drive better commercial and traveler outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

  

* Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption of **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** capabilities, including risk signals, predictive scores, and decisioning services that support protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands and markets.
* Define product strategies that optimize pricing decisions, product recommendations, inventory utilization, risk-adjusted profitability, and demand predictability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage data, AI, and machine learning to improve risk assessment, predictive decisioning, commercial optimization, and product performance.
* Translate product strategy into clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans while managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex platform initiatives.
* Drive 0-to-1 innovation by identifying and launching new monetization opportunities enabled through risk prediction, demand forecasting, price predictability, and decision intelligence.
* Bring execution rigor to turn these opportunities into 0-to-1 launches: scope tightly, sequence milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and ship on time and at quality, working hand in hand with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.

* Understand the value of fast, quality delivery: balance speed with reliability, compliance, and customer experience, using MVPs, experiments, and phased rollouts to learn quickly and scale what works.
Work directly with senior product leaders and executives, using exceptional presentation and storytelling skills to communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results clearly, and to influence leaders and stakeholders to back key decisions and investments.  

  

**Experience and qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, including platform, technical, or data-driven products serving multiple teams or business lines.
* Experience in FinTech, InsurTech, Payments, Marketplace, Travel, or E-commerce domains is strongly preferred. Experience with risk, fraud, underwriting, credit scoring, pricing, or decisioning platforms is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven track record of taking products from idea to launch: you have personally led multiple 0-to-1 launches end to end, from discovery and requirements through build, rollout, and post-launch adoption, partnering with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a solid understanding of machine learning, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
* Familiarity with forecasting, risk scoring, pricing optimization, demand prediction, inventory economics, and commercial decisioning frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and align stakeholders across multiple organizations to drive outcomes and investment.
* Experience operating in regulated environments such as insurance, financial services, payments, or travel, including an understanding of compliance and risk management considerations, is a strong plus.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.
