role_title: S2B Product Manager, Statements & Reporting, Digital Channel Solutions
title: S2B Product Manager, Statements & Reporting, Digital Channel Solutions
job_description:
Requisition Number: 66516

Job Location: Chennai, IND

Global Grade: Band 5

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 18/11/2026

Posting End Date: 06/12/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for corporate client Statements, Advice and Transactional Reporting across S2B Web, Host-to-Host, SWIFT and API channels.

• Develop a coherent omnichannel reporting experience that enables clients to discover, configure, receive, download and reconcile account information consistently, regardless of the channel used.
  
• Drive convergence of reporting journeys, data definitions, formats, entitlements and service standards across channels, while accommodating channel-specific client needs and integration models.
  
• Translate client, business, regulatory and servicing needs into secure, resilient and scalable prior-day and intraday reporting capabilities, using client usage analytics to improve adoption, simplify the estate and guide lifecycle decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap**  
• Define and maintain the global product vision, target-state architecture principles and multi-year roadmap for statements, account reporting, transaction reporting and advices across digital channels.
  
• Prioritise investments using client value, adoption, revenue enablement, regulatory obligations, service risk, architecture health and total cost of ownership; develop business cases and measurable outcomes.
  
• Benchmark market capabilities and emerging standards, converting insights into differentiated propositions and sequenced capability increments.

**Client Reporting Proposition and Standards**  
• Own the catalogue of prior-day and intraday statements, debit/credit advices, balance and transaction reports, including channel availability, eligibility, formats, service levels and client-facing documentation.
  
• Guide support for relevant reporting standards and formats, including SWIFT MT940/MT942, ISO 20022 camt.052/camt.053/camt.054, BAI2, CSV, PDF, XML and API payloads, with clear versioning and migration plans.
  
• Ensure consistent semantics, reconciliation behaviour, balances, value dates, transaction codes, references and data lineage across Web, H2H, SWIFT and API delivery.
  
**End-to-End Product Ownership and Agile Delivery**  
• Convert strategy and client needs into epics, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements; own backlog ordering and make transparent scope and trade-off decisions.
  
• Lead discovery, solution shaping, design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations, UAT, release readiness, production rollout and benefits validation with Technology, Architecture, Operations and servicing teams.
  
• Embed security, privacy, entitlement, auditability, accessibility, performance, availability, scalability and observability requirements from inception.

**Client Experience, Adoption and Commercialisation**  
**• Use research, servicing insights and journey mapping to simplify report discovery, subscription, configuration, scheduling, delivery, download and exception handling.**  
**• Partner with Sales, Implementation, Client Service and country/cluster teams on client propositions, complex solutioning, migration, launch communications, training and adoption campaigns.**  
**• Define and monitor success measures such as active clients, report delivery and download utilisation, migration progress, digital adoption, service availability, failure rates, latency and client feedback.**

**Data, Architecture and Service Resilience**  
**• Maintain an accurate current-state view of source systems, data flows, transformation rules, interfaces, loaders, schedulers and upstream/downstream dependencies, including ownership and service levels.**  
**• Drive convergence toward reusable data services and a common reporting architecture across Cash and, where relevant, Trade and FSS, reducing duplication and inconsistent client outcomes.**  
**• Own product response to incidents and recurring defects, ensuring root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resilience improvements and prioritisation of technical debt and single points of failure.**

**Risk, Governance and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Operate product governance across new capabilities, material changes and report retirement, including approvals, client impact assessment, migration, records retention, regulatory and compliance review, and operational readiness.**  
**• Maintain product standards, controls, risks, dependencies, decision records and audit evidence; ensure issues are escalated and remediated with clear ownership and closure criteria.**  
**• Use usage and cost analysis to identify reports for growth, consolidation or decommissioning, validating recommendations with product, country, technology, operations and client stakeholders.**

**Stakeholder Leadership and Decision Making**  
**• Act as the accountable product subject-matter expert, aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, Implementation and Client Service.**  
**• Communicate complex data and technology topics clearly to executive and delivery audiences; facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities and maintain momentum across globally distributed teams.**  
**• This is an individual-contributor Product Owner role with matrix leadership responsibility across multidisciplinary delivery teams and strategic partners.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Digital Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Transaction Banking Statements and Reporting**  
**• Agile Product Ownership and Backlog Management**  
**• Data Architecture, Integration and ISO 20022/SWIFT Standards**  
**• Risk, Controls and Operational Resilience**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Client Experience, Commercialisation and Adoption**  
**• Data Analytics and Product Performance Management**  
**• Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication**  
**• Service Management, Incident and Problem Management**  
**• Market and Competitive Analysis**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Solving complex client reporting and reconciliation challenges**

**• Driven to ensure data integrity and consistency across channels and transaction types, with aligned definitions, mappings, balances, references and reconciliation outcomes that clients can trust.**  
**• Building a coherent omnichannel experience across S2B Web, H2H, SWIFT and API**  
**• Leading collaboratively in regulated, globally distributed environments**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, cash management, corporate digital channels, data/reporting products or complex banking technology delivery.**  
**• Demonstrated Product Owner or Product Manager experience owning strategy, roadmap, backlog and end-to-end delivery for enterprise digital products.**  
**• Strong domain experience in corporate account information, statements, transaction reporting, advices or cash-management reporting across Web, H2H, SWIFT and/or API channels.**  
**• Practical experience with SWIFT account reporting and ISO 20022 cash-management messages; familiarity with MT940/942 and camt.052/053/054 is strongly preferred.**  
**• Experience translating data flows, source-to-target mappings, reconciliation rules and complex integrations into product requirements and client outcomes.**  
**• Track record of leading cross-functional delivery, UAT, releases, migrations, production incident remediation and lifecycle rationalisation in a regulated environment.**  
**• Strong analytical capability using product telemetry and client usage data; working knowledge of SQL, Power BI or Tableau is advantageous.**  
**• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams without direct authority.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory)**  
**• Degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.**  
**• Product Owner, Agile or Scrum certification is advantageous, not mandatory.**  
**• SWIFT, ISO 20022, cash-management or data-management training/certification is advantageous.**  
**Languages**  
**• Professional fluency in English; additional market languages are advantageous where relevant to the role scope.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for corporate non-interactive connectivity, with primary focus on Host-to-Host (H2H) and SWIFT FileAct.

• Deliver secure, scalable, resilient and well-controlled client journeys across onboarding, connectivity, file transmission, validation, payment and non-payment processing, monitoring, servicing and maintenance.
  
• Drive Data Quality detective controls and sustainable risk remediation by translating customer, business, regulatory, control and technology needs into strategic product capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Product strategy, ownership and commercial value**  
• Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, investment priorities and lifecycle for H2H and SWIFT FileAct across corporate and financial-institution clients. Translate client, market, regulatory and technology developments into a differentiated proposition with measurable adoption, revenue, client-experience, operational-efficiency and risk outcomes.
  
**End-to-end client connectivity journey**  
• Own the complete client journey from solutioning and technical onboarding through connectivity setup, testing, certification, implementation, go-live, servicing, maintenance and decommissioning. Simplify hand-offs, reduce implementation lead time and improve transparency across Sales, Implementation, Technology, Operations and Client Service.
  
**Connectivity, security and channel capabilities**  
• Define product requirements for secure and resilient file exchange across H2H and SWIFT FileAct, including SFTP, APIs where relevant, encryption, authentication, digital certificates, mTLS and certificate/key lifecycle controls. Ensure solutions support scalable connectivity patterns, appropriate segregation, auditability and secure client administration.
  
**File, Payment and Non-Payment processing**  
• Own capabilities for file receipt, validation, acknowledgement, routing, processing, status reporting, reconciliation and exception handling across payment and non-payment flows. Drive consistent support for agreed file formats and messaging standards, including ISO 20022 and SWIFT, while managing market, product and downstream-platform dependencies.

**Product discovery and client experience**  
**• Use client feedback, implementation experience, servicing data, operational insights and industry developments to identify friction and validate needs. Apply discovery, prototyping, MVP and fail-fast methods, and assess automation and AI opportunities that can simplify onboarding, file validation, investigation, exception management and servicing.**  
**Backlog, squad leadership and delivery execution**  
**• Own and prioritise the squad backlog and quarterly plan. Define epics, features, user stories, Gherkin acceptance criteria and functional and non-functional requirements; manage dependencies and trade-offs; and guide Engineering, Architecture and Testing teams through design, build, end-to-end validation, production readiness and implementation.**  
**Resilience, service performance and lifecycle health**  
**• Set requirements and success measures for availability, capacity, performance, recoverability, supportability and business continuity. Monitor post-implementation outcomes, service trends, incidents and recurring failure points; prioritise root-cause remediation, platform modernisation, standardisation and retirement of tactical or legacy solutions.**

**Data Quality, controls and regulatory readiness**  
**• Own the DQ strategic roadmap and risk-remediation backlog. Embed detective controls, exception monitoring, investigation, reconciliation and sustainable remediation across design, Definition of Ready, testing and Definition of Done. Support closure of relevant risk, regulatory, control and audit findings through strategic product and technology change.**  
**Governance, stakeholder leadership and decisions**  
**• Establish clear product governance, decision rights, success measures and benefit tracking. Partner with Product, Technology, Engineering, Architecture, Implementation, Operations, Client Service, Sales, Data, Information and Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance and Control Owners to resolve impediments, agree priorities and make transparent risk/value decisions.**  
**Role scope and conduct**  
**• Individual contributor role that leads through product accountability, squad direction, domain expertise, influence and cross-functional decision-making. Provide product sign-off when acceptance, testing, operational-readiness and control standards are met, and display exemplary conduct in line with the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management**  
**• Agile product ownership and backlog management**  
**• Corporate connectivity: H2H and SWIFT FileAct**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Payments, file processing, ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging**  
**• Data Quality, detective controls and risk remediation**  
**• eSDLC, CDS, ADO, user stories and acceptance criteria**  
**• Stakeholder management, influencing and dependency resolution**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Solving complex client and operational problems across corporate connectivity and payment journeys.**

**• Creating measurable improvements in digital onboarding, resilience, control effectiveness and client experience.**  
**• Leading cross-functional delivery in a global environment that values evidence, experimentation, accountability and sustainable outcomes.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• 8+ years of relevant experience in banking, financial services, transaction banking, digital channels, payments, technology or product management, preferably in a global organisation.**  
**• Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Senior Business Analyst or comparable role delivering complex banking or technology products using Agile methods.**  
**• Experience with corporate connectivity, preferably H2H and/or SWIFT-based channels, and with payments, file processing, system integration or corporate digital channels.**  
**• Working knowledge of ISO 20022, SWIFT messaging and file-based payment integration.**  
**• High-level understanding of SFTP, APIs, encryption, digital certificates, mTLS, authentication and certificate/key lifecycle concepts.**  
**• Experience across discovery, requirements, development, testing, implementation and post-production review, with strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management capability.**  
**• Experience or strong understanding of Data Quality, operational risk, detective controls or risk-remediation initiatives is highly desirable.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**  
**• No mandatory certification specified. Relevant Agile or product-management qualifications are advantageous but not essential.**  
**Languages** **: English – professional working proficiency.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

### **General Information**

Req #

WD00108702

Monday, November 16, 2026

Working time:

Full-time

* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

  
  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the global product vision and strategy for Offer-to-Glass.
* Translate Digital Commerce strategy and OGSM priorities into an outcome-based product roadmap.
* Establish a clear definition of what constitutes a complete, accurate, sellable, and customer-ready offer.
* Balance near-term commercial requirements with global scalability, simplification, automation, and longer-term platform capabilities.

**Offer Readiness & Digital Shelf**

* Own the product capabilities required to move approved offers onto the digital shelf.
* Ensure product information, attributes, taxonomy, digital assets, localized content, pricing, promotions, and availability information can be accurately represented in the customer experience.
* Identify breakdowns between source systems and what customers ultimately see on Lenovo.com.
* Establish monitoring and measures that assess the actual customer-facing offer rather than relying solely on upstream system status.

**Roadmap, Prioritization & Investment**

* Maintain a single, prioritized roadmap and backlog for Offer-to-Glass.
* Bring Geo and business-unit demand into the product model rather than managing requests as disconnected local projects.
* Prioritize according to customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, evidence, dependencies, risk, and effort.
* Make clear trade-offs when demand exceeds available capacity or funding.

**Product Discovery**

* Lead continuous discovery to understand why products and offers become delayed, incomplete, inaccurate, incorrectly priced, unavailable, or otherwise unsellable.
* Use customer research, analytics, operational data, business feedback, and experimentation to validate problems before committing significant investment.
* Define problem statements, hypotheses, expected outcomes, and success measures before moving into delivery.

**Delivery, Launch & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain product accountability from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and improvement.
* Partner with Technology and Engineering on scope, sequencing, release, and technical dependencies while retaining accountability for the product outcome.
* Ensure capabilities are adopted across markets and transition appropriate steady-state processes to operational teams.
* Monitor production performance and place corrective work back into the roadmap when offers are wrong, missing, or unsellable.

**Global & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Align Digital Commerce, Geo commerce teams, merchandising, pricing, Product, Design, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and business units around shared outcomes.
* Establish clear decision rights and handoffs with adjacent product domains.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, investment needs, progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Lead through influence within a global, highly matrixed organization.

The Senior Product Manager should establish baselines and targets covering:

* Accuracy of products, prices, promotions, and offer information on Lenovo.com
* Percentage of intended assortment that is live and sellable
* Time from approved offer or price change to customer visibility
* Product/content/data completeness
* Accuracy of availability and delivery signals
* Reduction in offers that are missing, incorrect, or unsellable
* Production regressions affecting live offers
* Time to detect and resolve offer-related issues
* Global adoption of capabilities versus market-specific duplication
* Commercial impact attributable to improved offer readiness and merchandising capabilities

**Additional Locations**:

* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore

* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

* India

* India - Karnātaka

\* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore , \* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

**NOTICE FOR PUBLIC**

  

At Lenovo, we follow strict policies and legal compliance for our recruitment process, which includes role alignment, employment terms discussion, final selection and offer approval, and recording transactions in our internal system. Interviews may be conducted via audio, video, or in-person depending on the role, and you will always meet with an official Lenovo representative.

Please beware of fraudulent recruiters posing as Lenovo representatives. They may request cash deposits or personal information. Always apply through official Lenovo channels and never share sensitive information. Lenovo does not solicit money or sensitive information from applicants and will not request payments for training or equipment.

Kindly verify job offers through the official Lenovo careers page or contact IndiaTA@lenovo.com. Stay informed and cautious to protect yourself from recruitment fraud. Report any suspicious activity to local authorities.

job_description:
Years of Experience: 12–15 Years

Location: Noida

Work from Office

##### **Role Purpose**

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product
  
identification through specification finalisation, development, certification, launch
  
and lifecycle management. Turn market insights into differentiated products and bring
  
clear recommendations to management on product priorities, investment and
  
sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

**Certifications, testing and compliance:**

* Identify applicable standards, certifications and tender-related compliance
    
  requirements for each product. Incorporate them into specifications, test plans
    
  and release schedules
* Coordinate testing and documentation with Development, Quality, vendors and
    
  external laboratories or certification agencies. Track gaps, corrective actions, test
    
  evidence and approvals through closure.
* Maintain a product-wise compliance matrix and track certificate validity,
    
  renewals and the impact of hardware, firmware or software changes on existing
    
  approvals.

**Vendor communication and sourcing optimisation:**

* Lead product and technical discussions with OEMs, component suppliers and
    
  technology partners. Evaluate samples, capabilities, customisation options and
    
  support commitments.
* Work with Procurement, Development and Quality to optimise bill-of-materials
    
  cost and lead times, qualify alternate sources and reduce single-source
    
  dependencies.
* Validate sourcing changes against agreed specifications, field reliability, warranty
    
  implications and certification requirements before approval.

**Monthly management review and reporting:**

* Prepare and circulate a monthly product report covering emerging product
    
  opportunities, market and competitor developments, roadmap milestones,
    
  specification sign-offs, pilots, certification status, sourcing metrics, risks and
    
  decisions required.
* Lead the monthly management review. Present options, trade-offs and a
    
  recommendation for each decision on which opportunities to pursue, defer or
    
  close, along with decisions on roadmap priorities, investment, specification
    
  changes, certification spend, vendor selection and launch readiness.
* Record decisions, action owners and due dates. Track actions to closure and
    
  escalate blockers that require attention before the next review.

##### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology, with demonstrated ownership of
    
  hardware and software products or integrated solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. An MBA is
    
  desirable.
* Experience in intelligent traffic systems, smart or safe cities, surveillance, AI
    
  video analytics, industrial IoT or embedded systems is preferred.

##### **Core Capabilities**

* Proven ability to identify and validate new market opportunities and take
    
  products from specification through pilot, certification, launch and post-launch
    
  review.
* Experience engaging customers, consultants and system integrators and
    
  translating their inputs into product and commercial decisions.
* Working knowledge of vendor qualification, product costing, alternate sourcing
    
  and compliance documentation.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and present concise, evidence-based
    
  recommendations to senior management.
text:
Years of Experience: 12–15 Years

Location: Noida

Work from Office

##### **Role Purpose**

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product
  
identification through specification finalisation, development, certification, launch
  
and lifecycle management. Turn market insights into differentiated products and bring
  
clear recommendations to management on product priorities, investment and
  
sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

**Certifications, testing and compliance:**

* Identify applicable standards, certifications and tender-related compliance
    
  requirements for each product. Incorporate them into specifications, test plans
    
  and release schedules
* Coordinate testing and documentation with Development, Quality, vendors and
    
  external laboratories or certification agencies. Track gaps, corrective actions, test
    
  evidence and approvals through closure.
* Maintain a product-wise compliance matrix and track certificate validity,
    
  renewals and the impact of hardware, firmware or software changes on existing
    
  approvals.

**Vendor communication and sourcing optimisation:**

* Lead product and technical discussions with OEMs, component suppliers and
    
  technology partners. Evaluate samples, capabilities, customisation options and
    
  support commitments.
* Work with Procurement, Development and Quality to optimise bill-of-materials
    
  cost and lead times, qualify alternate sources and reduce single-source
    
  dependencies.
* Validate sourcing changes against agreed specifications, field reliability, warranty
    
  implications and certification requirements before approval.

**Monthly management review and reporting:**

* Prepare and circulate a monthly product report covering emerging product
    
  opportunities, market and competitor developments, roadmap milestones,
    
  specification sign-offs, pilots, certification status, sourcing metrics, risks and
    
  decisions required.
* Lead the monthly management review. Present options, trade-offs and a
    
  recommendation for each decision on which opportunities to pursue, defer or
    
  close, along with decisions on roadmap priorities, investment, specification
    
  changes, certification spend, vendor selection and launch readiness.
* Record decisions, action owners and due dates. Track actions to closure and
    
  escalate blockers that require attention before the next review.

##### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology, with demonstrated ownership of
    
  hardware and software products or integrated solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. An MBA is
    
  desirable.
* Experience in intelligent traffic systems, smart or safe cities, surveillance, AI
    
  video analytics, industrial IoT or embedded systems is preferred.

##### **Core Capabilities**

* Proven ability to identify and validate new market opportunities and take
    
  products from specification through pilot, certification, launch and post-launch
    
  review.
* Experience engaging customers, consultants and system integrators and
    
  translating their inputs into product and commercial decisions.
* Working knowledge of vendor qualification, product costing, alternate sourcing
    
  and compliance documentation.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and present concise, evidence-based
    
  recommendations to senior management.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

title: Senior Product Manager - Onboarding & Activation
job_description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will own Accelerate's growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an  
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.

**What you will own:**

* Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what "activated" means for each.
* Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
* Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
* Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
* Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
* Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
* Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
* Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
* A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
* Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
* Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.

**Strong pluses:**

* Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
* Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
* Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
* Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
* Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

* APIs and headless access. A public API so partners and larger customers can create and manage campaigns without using our UI. You own the developer experience, docs and pricing model, working with engineering on the design.

* You have shipped an LLM-powered product to real users in production, not just a pilot or demo. You have dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost and quality regressions.
* Hands-on understanding of RAG, prompt design, agentic workflows and evals. You have written eval sets yourself and used them to decide whether something ships.
* Strong design sense. You can show work where you shaped the experience in detail, and you partner with designers as a peer.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a wide scope. You can keep the hero surface moving while building the API and partnership tracks alongside it.
* Clear written communication with engineers, designers, business partners and customers.

* Experience in martech, adtech or performance marketing products, or time as a performance marketer yourself.
* Built or owned a public API, developer platform or partner app (for example, a Shopify app or a payment-platform integration).
* Shipped a product that serves both self-serve SMBs and enterprise or agency accounts from one codebase.
* Experience with generative creative: image, video or ad copy generation with brand-safety checks.
* A portfolio or public writing showing your product and design thinking.

**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
The Analytics & AI Delivery Manager for Sourcing is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI product delivery for Power’s Sourcing organization. This leadership role ensures that analytical and AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.
  
  
Serving as a strategic bridge across executive business stakeholders, Digital Technology, analytics operations, AI Foundry, Power teams, the leader will establish the product vision, define complex business and technical requirements, and translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric Analytics and AI solutions. The role will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, drive adoption and integration into day-to-day operations, and continuously improve product performance across the Sourcing domain.
  
  
As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will oversee overall AI product delivery—from data readiness assessments and Proof-of-Concept execution through MVP delivery, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining deep business-process understanding with strategic roadmap ownership and disciplined delivery oversight, the leader will ensure that data and AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* **AI Data Readiness and Delivery**: Partner with the AI Strategy Data Science and AI Architecture teams to lead data-readiness activities, technical execution of proofs of concept, MVP development, and the scaling of validated solutions into high-impact, production-grade AI products.

* **AI Strategy and Demand Management:** Partner with the AI Strategy Portfolio team to build and maintain a strong demand pipeline, establish effective intake and prioritization processes, and enable a stable, scalable AI delivery model.

* **Data and Analytics Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership**: Partner with Data Architects to define and execute the end-to-end roadmap for data, analytics, and AI products—from ideation and proof of concept through MVP delivery, production deployment, and ongoing product optimization.

* **Partner and Capacity Management:** Translate demand and priorities from the agile planning process into actionable capacity plans. Lead the Program Increment planning process and work with OCIO and strategic partners to onboard the right resources and capabilities for both analytics and AI delivery.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Serve as the primary liaison among executive stakeholders, Digital Technology, business operations, and delivery partners to align requirements, priorities, and execution with strategic business objectives.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive simplification, standardization, and delivery rigor by facilitating workshops and implementing improvements across tools, processes, and workflows.

* **Requirements and Backlog Management**: Translate complex business needs into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs using agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Team Description
  
  
We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Digital Experience team. The team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners, connecting complex airline and retailing capabilities with modern digital experiences to deliver seamless traveler journeys.

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help drive the roadmap and execution of our **Digital Experience (DX)** product across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery, commercial teams and global airline customers to translate business and customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

  

The role combines product strategy with hands-on execution. You will manage roadmap priorities and customer requirements, guide agile backlogs, partner with technical teams on solution direction, and help evolve our products as the airline industry transitions toward modern Offer & Order retailing.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve product roadmaps for Digital Experience capabilities across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic, balancing strategic roadmap priorities, customer commitments and platform modernization.
* Manage product requirements and priorities for DX and DXCI, including customer change requests, roadmap initiatives and ongoing product enhancements.
* Translate customer and business needs into clearly defined product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for agile engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand technical trade-offs and deliver scalable product capabilities.
* Work directly with global airline customers, delivery teams and commercial stakeholders to understand requirements, identify product gaps and shape product priorities.
* Support the evolution of digital experiences as airline customers transition from traditional PNR-based workflows toward Offer & Order retailing.
* Analyze product issues, customer escalations and maintenance requirements in partnership with engineering and delivery teams, helping determine appropriate product solutions.
* Use customer feedback, product data, industry trends and operational insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, roadmap discussions and capability presentations to internal stakeholders and global airline customers.
Coordinate across multiple parallel initiatives and customer commitments while maintaining clear prioritization and product direction.  

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

* 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, preferably working with complex enterprise software, e-commerce platforms or high-scale digital products.
* Demonstrated experience owning product capabilities through the full lifecycle, from requirements and prioritization through development, release and ongoing evolution.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum software development environment, including backlog management, story refinement and acceptance criteria.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand how APIs, backend services, platform capabilities and frontend experiences work together.
* Experience engaging directly with customers or partners to understand needs, define requirements and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess competing requirements and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex product and technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives and customer priorities simultaneously in a global environment.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
The Oracle Health Medication Administration team delivers solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is a critical part of care delivery, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.

Our mission is to support and improve the medication administration capabilities customers depend on every day. We focus on product reliability, effective clinical workflows, customer responsiveness, and practical enhancements that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety.

We are seeking a **Product Manager 2** to support medication administration products and contributing to requirements definition and product development for medication administration. This role emphasizes understanding current customer workflows, helping address product issues, documenting requirements, validating solutions, and supporting release readiness and adoption. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering, UX, regulatory & compliance, support, consulting, and customer-facing teams.

Working with guidance from senior team members, you will contribute to product decisions and roadmap priorities for assigned capabilities. You will be accountable for progressing assigned deliverables, communicating status, and escalating risks or decisions requiring broader review. Your work will help maintain reliable medication administration experiences for clinicians and the patients they serve.

  

* **Product Support and Maintenance:** Support medication administration capabilities used by Oracle Health customers. Assist in reviewing customer-reported issues, defects, workflow gaps, and adoption barriers. Gather relevant information and work with senior product managers and cross-functional partners to support investigation, prioritization, resolution, and customer communication.
* **Product Requirements and Feature Definition:** Develop and maintain requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation for assigned fixes and enhancements, with guidance and review. Collaborate with product and engineering to clarify expected behavior and ensure requirements are actionable and testable.
* **Roadmap Contribution and Execution:** Share responsibility with senior product managers for the roadmap of assigned capabilities. Provide input based on customer feedback, support trends, product quality, and workflow needs. Support agreed priorities across maintenance, enhancements, technical debt, and lifecycle activities.
* **Clinical Workflow Understanding:** Develop a working understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, and clinical communication. Partner with clinical experts to understand current workflows and validate proposed changes.
* **Customer and User Engagement:** Participate in customer and internal stakeholder discussions to capture requirements, understand workflow challenges, and gather feedback. Advocate for customer needs with guidance, document findings, and support follow-up on product questions and issues.
* **Product Validation, Safety, and Quality:** Contribute to user testing and perform feature acceptance testing against agreed requirements. Identify workflow gaps, unexpected behavior, and potential safety concerns, and escalate them to appropriate product, clinical safety, quality, and engineering partners.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with engineering, UX, regulatory & compliance, support, consulting, and related product teams on assigned work. Define requirements, identify risks and hazards, track dependencies, and facilitate alignment across teams within the department. Seek senior guidance when priorities, ownership, or tradeoffs require resolution.
* **Regulatory and Compliance Support:** Work with subject matter experts to capture applicable regulatory, accreditation, medication safety, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Maintain related product artifacts with oversight and support review of changes affecting existing capabilities.
* **Release Readiness and Customer Adoption:** Support release planning, acceptance testing, release notes, user documentation, training materials, and demonstrations. Assist with customer readiness and early-adopter activities, including gathering feedback and tracking follow-up items.
* **Product Analysis and Continuous Improvement:** Review customer feedback, service requests, defects, usage data, and adoption trends to identify opportunities for improvement. Partner with senior team members to track agreed success measures and evaluate whether changes address the intended customer need. Maintain awareness of relevant industry practices and share findings that inform assigned work.
* **Planning and Execution:** Track assigned timelines and deliverables with minimal supervision. Adjust work as priorities or resources change, with some guidance. Communicate progress, identify risks, and escalate issues that may affect quality or delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of product requirements, roadmap execution, and cross-functional product delivery.
* Experience contributing to requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, or workflow documentation.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, quality assurance, UX, support, or other cross-functional teams.
* Ability to gather and analyze customer feedback and product information to understand problems and contribute to practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions, document decisions, and communicate with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned deliverables, track timelines, and adjust priorities with guidance.
* Sound judgment in identifying issues, seeking input, and escalating decisions appropriately.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Healthcare IT, Clinical Informatics, Nursing Informatics, Pharmacy Informatics, Electronic Health Records, or related healthcare technology domains.
* Familiarity with medication administration workflows, medication safety principles, clinical documentation, or medication management systems.
* Experience supporting existing or legacy software products, including customer issue review, defect triage, maintenance releases, or incremental enhancements.
* Experience documenting clinical workflows and contributing to software requirements.
* Experience supporting healthcare customers or participating in software implementations.
* Familiarity with barcode medication administration, infusion management, smart device integrations, interoperability, or clinical decision support.
* Experience with software testing, feature acceptance, release documentation, or customer readiness activities.
* Familiarity with Agile software development practices.
* Experience working in environments with patient safety, privacy, security, quality, or compliance requirements.

* **Roadmap Contribution and Execution:** Share responsibility with senior product managers for the roadmap of assigned capabilities. Provide input based on customer feedback, support trends, product quality, and workflow needs. Support agreed priorities across maintenance, enhancements, technical debt, and lifecycle activities.
* **Clinical Workflow Understanding:** Develop a working understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, and clinical communication. Partner with clinical experts to understand current workflows and validate proposed changes.
* **Customer and User Engagement:** Participate in customer and internal stakeholder discussions to capture requirements, understand workflow challenges, and gather feedback. Advocate for customer needs with guidance, document findings, and support follow-up on product questions and issues.
* **Product Validation, Safety, and Quality:** Contribute to user testing and perform feature acceptance testing against agreed requirements. Identify workflow gaps, unexpected behavior, and potential safety concerns, and escalate them to appropriate product, clinical safety, quality, and engineering partners.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with engineering, UX, regulatory & compliance, support, consulting, and related product teams on assigned work. Define requirements, identify risks and hazards, track dependencies, and facilitate alignment across teams within the department. Seek senior guidance when priorities, ownership, or tradeoffs require resolution.
* **Regulatory and Compliance Support:** Work with subject matter experts to capture applicable regulatory, accreditation, medication safety, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Maintain related product artifacts with oversight and support review of changes affecting existing capabilities.
* **Release Readiness and Customer Adoption:** Support release planning, acceptance testing, release notes, user documentation, training materials, and demonstrations. Assist with customer readiness and early-adopter activities, including gathering feedback and tracking follow-up items.
* **Product Analysis and Continuous Improvement:** Review customer feedback, service requests, defects, usage data, and adoption trends to identify opportunities for improvement. Partner with senior team members to track agreed success measures and evaluate whether changes address the intended customer need. Maintain awareness of relevant industry practices and share findings that inform assigned work.
* **Planning and Execution:** Track assigned timelines and deliverables with minimal supervision. Adjust work as priorities or resources change, with some guidance. Communicate progress, identify risks, and escalate issues that may affect quality or delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of product requirements, roadmap execution, and cross-functional product delivery.
* Experience contributing to requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, or workflow documentation.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, quality assurance, UX, support, or other cross-functional teams.
* Ability to gather and analyze customer feedback and product information to understand problems and contribute to practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions, document decisions, and communicate with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned deliverables, track timelines, and adjust priorities with guidance.
* Sound judgment in identifying issues, seeking input, and escalating decisions appropriately.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Healthcare IT, Clinical Informatics, Nursing Informatics, Pharmacy Informatics, Electronic Health Records, or related healthcare technology domains.
* Familiarity with medication administration workflows, medication safety principles, clinical documentation, or medication management systems.
* Experience supporting existing or legacy software products, including customer issue review, defect triage, maintenance releases, or incremental enhancements.
* Experience documenting clinical workflows and contributing to software requirements.
* Experience supporting healthcare customers or participating in software implementations.
* Familiarity with barcode medication administration, infusion management, smart device integrations, interoperability, or clinical decision support.
* Experience with software testing, feature acceptance, release documentation, or customer readiness activities.
* Familiarity with Agile software development practices.
* Experience working in environments with patient safety, privacy, security, quality, or compliance requirements.
