job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

**Skills**

Agentic Platforms, Global Supply Chain, Global Supply Chain Strategy, Pharmaceutical Supply Chain, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Sr Product manager
job_description:
**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritise relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

**Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics** is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyse both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.

**About the Job:**

The Senior Product Manager - Inventory Purchasing and Positioning is responsible for executing the strategy and this role will lead the product design, delivery of modern inventory systems. Our team and products enable the ability for Inventory Management teams to effectively manage the synchronized flow of inventory into and throughout Target's supply chain network. This role will work closely with supply chain product/business partners, enterprise capacity planning and data science teams. This role will act as the subject matter expert (SME) for the engineering teams and lead the development of the prioritized features along with systematic scale and performance enhancements to support business growth.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritise the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, operations, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories & acceptance criteria) while prioritising the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders. You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**Reporting/Working Relationships**

* Reports to Director, Product Management
* Located at Target India.
* Working Relationships: Works closely with Target Tech engineering teams and business product teams in India and United States, Global Supply Chain & Logistics, Digital, Stores, Target Finance and Accounting, enterprise capacity planning and Data Science

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 8+ years Supply chain experience
* 3+ years’ experience with Purchasing and Positioning
* 4+ years’ experience working in product and agile model
* Knowledge of Procurement – First mile, Replenishment, Order Management, Optimization/Sub optimization, TMS, WMS, Carrier Labeling and interactions
* Knowledge of B2B interactions (EDI, XML, APIs)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong business, technology and data acumen with interest towards AI/ML solutions.
* Strong communication skills w/ proven ability to communicate across business and technology teams as well as different levels of leadership.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

title: Sr Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa is seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of enterprise Data Governance Platforms. This role will help shape how Visa discovers, understands, governs, measures, and trusts data across the enterprise through capabilities spanning metadata management, data quality, governance workflows, semantic capabilities, domain ownership, and related data governance technologies. The Product Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Governance, Privacy, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that improve data trust, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision making.

Essential Functions:

* Define vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for one or more enterprise data governance platforms.
* Align platform investments with enterprise data strategy, governance objectives, AI readiness, cloud transformation, and business priorities.
* Manage portfolio priorities, investment tradeoffs, and roadmap sequencing.
* Maintain and prioritize product backlogs, epics, features, and business requirements.
* Partner with engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Define acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple products, teams, and stakeholders.
* Conduct customer discovery and requirements gathering.
* Partner with governance, privacy, risk, architecture, and business teams to identify opportunities and pain points.
* Drive adoption through communication, enablement, onboarding, and feedback programs.
* Translate governance policies and business requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
* Support capabilities including metadata management, data quality, stewardship, governance workflows, access controls, certification, lineage, business definitions, semantic models, and trust indicators.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define integration strategies across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with adjacent platforms supporting analytics, AI/ML, reporting, data engineering, governance, and operational workflows.
* Drive interoperability between governance platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Evaluate commercial, cloud-native, and open-source technologies.
* Conduct product assessments and develop build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Stay current on trends in data governance, metadata management, data quality, AI governance, semantic technologies, and observability.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 10 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 7 or more years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or a related discipline supporting enterprise data, analytics, governance, or technology platforms.
* Experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics for enterprise platforms, with a demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in one or more data management domains, including Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalogs, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management, Data Observability, Semantic Technologies, or related capabilities.
* Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, databases, APIs, data integration patterns, and distributed data architectures.
* Experience partnering closely with engineering, architecture, governance, security, compliance, privacy, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and drive outcomes in complex organizational environments.
* Experience with Agile product development methodologies, including roadmap planning, backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and release planning.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, interpret data, identify opportunities, and make informed product decisions.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior leadership.
* Experience evaluating vendor solutions, commercial software products, cloud-native capabilities, and emerging technologies, including development of build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Experience with cloud technologies, enterprise data platforms, databases, SQL, and data engineering concepts.
* Prior experience within financial services, banking, payments, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is preferred.
* Advanced degrees desirable.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Overview:

Visa is seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of enterprise Data Governance Platforms. This role will help shape how Visa discovers, understands, governs, measures, and trusts data across the enterprise through capabilities spanning metadata management, data quality, governance workflows, semantic capabilities, domain ownership, and related data governance technologies. The Product Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Governance, Privacy, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that improve data trust, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision making.

Essential Functions:

* Define vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for one or more enterprise data governance platforms.
* Align platform investments with enterprise data strategy, governance objectives, AI readiness, cloud transformation, and business priorities.
* Manage portfolio priorities, investment tradeoffs, and roadmap sequencing.
* Maintain and prioritize product backlogs, epics, features, and business requirements.
* Partner with engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Define acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple products, teams, and stakeholders.
* Conduct customer discovery and requirements gathering.
* Partner with governance, privacy, risk, architecture, and business teams to identify opportunities and pain points.
* Drive adoption through communication, enablement, onboarding, and feedback programs.
* Translate governance policies and business requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
* Support capabilities including metadata management, data quality, stewardship, governance workflows, access controls, certification, lineage, business definitions, semantic models, and trust indicators.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define integration strategies across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with adjacent platforms supporting analytics, AI/ML, reporting, data engineering, governance, and operational workflows.
* Drive interoperability between governance platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Evaluate commercial, cloud-native, and open-source technologies.
* Conduct product assessments and develop build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Stay current on trends in data governance, metadata management, data quality, AI governance, semantic technologies, and observability.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 10 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 7 or more years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or a related discipline supporting enterprise data, analytics, governance, or technology platforms.
* Experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics for enterprise platforms, with a demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in one or more data management domains, including Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalogs, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management, Data Observability, Semantic Technologies, or related capabilities.
* Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, databases, APIs, data integration patterns, and distributed data architectures.
* Experience partnering closely with engineering, architecture, governance, security, compliance, privacy, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and drive outcomes in complex organizational environments.
* Experience with Agile product development methodologies, including roadmap planning, backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and release planning.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, interpret data, identify opportunities, and make informed product decisions.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior leadership.
* Experience evaluating vendor solutions, commercial software products, cloud-native capabilities, and emerging technologies, including development of build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Experience with cloud technologies, enterprise data platforms, databases, SQL, and data engineering concepts.
* Prior experience within financial services, banking, payments, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is preferred.
* Advanced degrees desirable.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager, Mobile
job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As the Sr. Product Manager for Mobile you will focus on delivering impactful innovations further accelerating the growth of Docusign's top-rated eSignature mobile apps, which is an important part of our millions of users' journey as we embrace the "anywhere economy". You will drive solutions that allow our customers to get to agreement anywhere on any device. You will work with cross-functional leaders to define a multi-year strategy and lead the efforts to build the roadmap, vision, and priorities for supporting this priority product area. You will deeply understand how Docusign can best deliver for our customers' needs and work with product development teams across Docusign to deliver product capabilities and solutions that support customers end-to-end agreement flows on mobile. Interacting directly with customers to validate needs will be a key part of your role.

Docusign has built award winning and the most pervasive technology for enabling businesses to automate their agreement processes - from generating agreements, negotiating between parties, getting agreements electronically signed, managing the workflows and integrations once an agreement is signed and analyzing and deriving insights from agreements. Today, Docusign's products meet the needs of customers extending from individual consumers to large Enterprises. You will serve as the subject matter expert guiding product development teams on what capabilities and solutions will best meet customers' mobile needs for their agreement challenges. Using qualitative and quantitative insights, you will deliver a strategy and product roadmap that both transforms how Docusign meets customer needs and drives measurable impact. In this position you will work cross-functionally with Design, Marketing, and Engineering and engage directly with customers to experiment and iterate.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Prioritize opportunities and lead product strategy and roadmaps focused on customer and business impact
* Build roadmaps by synthesizing customer needs, user research, data science, market and competitive insights, marketing input, and field feedback
* Develop a deep understanding of target personas, workflows, pain points, and jobs to be done through customer engagement and lifecycle research-from awareness and evaluation through adoption, renewal, and expansion
* Review competitors, vendors, adjacent solutions, industry trends, and relevant market channels to anticipate customer needs and identify opportunities for differentiation
* Define product vision, requirements, and functional specifications; translate them into developer-ready epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize and manage the feature backlog, dependencies, and tradeoffs to support effective release and sprint planning
* Lead and motivate a team of engineers and cross-functional representatives toward shared product outcomes
* Partner with Engineering, Design, User Experience, Research, and Program Management to take features from concept through launch while meeting quality, usability, performance, and reliability expectations
* Build business cases and gain stakeholder alignment for new capabilities, investments, and innovations
* Monitor, measure, and report on key business, product, and customer metrics; use telemetry, experimentation, and qualitative and quantitative feedback to drive continuous testing and optimization
* Identify and profile high-value use cases, partners, platforms, APIs, integrations, and ecosystem relationships that can expand product value and adoption
* Collaborate with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Support, Legal, Security, Compliance, Finance, and Business Development on go-to-market execution, enablement, adoption, and ongoing product growth
* Ensure product decisions account for applicable privacy, security, accessibility, legal, regulatory, and industry requirements
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 8+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree, or 6+ years of relevant experience and a master's degree
* Experience in product management supporting SaaS products or technology-enabled services
* Experience delivering native mobile apps for iOS or Android using iterative or Agile methodologies
* Experience with usability principles and practices, including early and rapid prototyping and usability testing
* Experience with tools such as Mixpanel, Optimizely, JIRA, or comparable analytics, experimentation, and Scrum tools
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and delivering products using iterative or Agile methodologies, such as Scrum
* Experience with enterprise technology ecosystems, platforms, APIs, integrations, and common customer workflows

  

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Business Systems, or a related engineering or technical discipline
* Experience taking a product or major feature from concept to launch and through ongoing adoption and optimization
* Application of qualitative and quantitative testing and analysis to feature development and product decisions
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect strategy, customer needs, research, data, competitive intelligence, and industry trends
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Ability to influence others, build alignment, and deliver results in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* Success managing large-scale, new, existing, or legacy technology products across complex customer or business environments
* Proficiency in defining product success metrics, building dashboards or telemetry, and using data to evaluate product performance and guide prioritization
* Strong customer focus, including customer discovery, solution validation, and translation of insights into measurable improvements in customer outcomes
* Business case development and stakeholder buy-in for product investments, partnerships, and innovation
* Collaboration with partners and external stakeholders to scale product capabilities, integrations, or distribution
* Involvement in product launches, enablement, change management, and adoption across multiple customer segments or geographies
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, User Experience, Research, Product, Program Management, Sales, Marketing, IT, Compliance, Security, Legal, Business Development, and Support
* Background in consulting, marketing, strategy, operations, or related disciplines involving risk management, privacy, information security, compliance, or regulatory controls
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**Overview**

Microsoft's 1P Privacy team builds and operates large-scale privacy infrastructure that enables Microsoft products and services to meet global privacy and regulatory requirements.

Our platforms power data discovery, classification, governance, and Data Subject Request (DSR) processing across Microsoft's extensive data ecosystem.

We are transforming our privacy platforms by simplifying complex workflows, modernizing infrastructure, and leveraging AI and automation to make privacy compliance more efficient, reliable, and scalable.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about building technically sophisticated products, solving complex customer problems, and driving meaningful product outcomes.

In this role, you will own key product capabilities within the 1P Privacy ecosystem, working closely with engineering, security, compliance, and partner teams across Microsoft.

You will be responsible for translating customer needs and business priorities into clear product requirements, driving execution, and delivering measurable improvements in product adoption, usability, and compliance effectiveness.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Independently own and deliver meaningful product capabilities.

* Develop a deep understanding of customer problems and translate them into effective product solutions.

* Drive measurable improvements in product adoption, usability, and operational efficiency.

* Build strong partnerships with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Make sound product decisions by balancing technical complexity, customer needs, and business priorities.

* Consistently deliver high-quality product outcomes while contributing to the broader 1P Privacy strategy.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically strong product manager who enjoys working closely with engineering teams to solve complex problems.

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, understanding technical systems, engaging with customers, and translating complex requirements into clear product direction.

You take ownership, make thoughtful decisions, collaborate effectively, and focus on delivering meaningful customer and business impact.

 **Responsibilities**

Product Strategy and Ownership

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned capabilities within the 1P Privacy platform.

* Identify customer problems, define product requirements, and prioritize investments based on customer value, compliance impact, and engineering feasibility.

* Drive product initiatives independently from problem discovery through development, launch, and adoption.

* Make informed prioritization decisions by balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business objectives.

* Define success metrics and continuously evaluate product effectiveness.

Technical Product Management

* Partner closely with engineering teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure platform capabilities.

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, and service integrations.

* Participate in technical design discussions, understand architectural trade-offs, and influence product decisions.

* Collaborate with engineering teams on platform modernization, performance, reliability, and security improvements.

Customer Experience and Product Adoption:

* Engage directly with internal Microsoft engineering teams to understand their workflows, challenges, and unmet needs.

* Simplify complex privacy compliance experiences, including data onboarding, asset discovery, ownership management, tagging, and agent integration.

* Translate customer feedback into actionable product improvements.

* Drive intuitive, accessible, and self-service product experiences.

* Develop product adoption strategies and measure customer engagement and satisfaction.

AI and Automation

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to simplify privacy workflows and reduce manual effort.

* Drive intelligent product experiences such as guided workflows, automated recommendations, and AI-assisted compliance operations.

* Partner with engineering teams to evaluate feasibility, effectiveness, and responsible adoption of AI-powered capabilities.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Execution

* Collaborate with engineering, privacy, legal, security, and partner product teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

* Drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and dependencies.

* Create clear product specifications, user scenarios, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

* Proactively identify risks, resolve ambiguity, and unblock execution.

* Communicate product priorities, progress, and outcomes effectively to stakeholders.

Data-Driven Product Improvement

* Establish product KPIs covering adoption, usability, operational efficiency, and compliance effectiveness.

* Leverage telemetry, customer feedback, and analytics to identify opportunities and prioritize improvements.

* Measure product outcomes and drive continuous improvement based on data.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Independently own and deliver meaningful product capabilities.

* Develop a deep understanding of customer problems and translate them into effective product solutions.

* Drive measurable improvements in product adoption, usability, and operational efficiency.

* Build strong partnerships with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Make sound product decisions by balancing technical complexity, customer needs, and business priorities.

* Consistently deliver high-quality product outcomes while contributing to the broader 1P Privacy strategy.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically strong product manager who enjoys working closely with engineering teams to solve complex problems.

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, understanding technical systems, engaging with customers, and translating complex requirements into clear product direction.

You take ownership, make thoughtful decisions, collaborate effectively, and focus on delivering meaningful customer and business impact.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, software engineering, or related technical roles.

* Demonstrated experience defining requirements and delivering complex software products or platform capabilities.

* Strong technical understanding of cloud services, distributed systems, APIs, and data platforms.

* Experience collaborating with engineering teams on technical designs and implementation trade-offs.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven product decisions.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration skills.

* Demonstrated ability to independently own product initiatives and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building or managing enterprise cloud platforms, developer tools, or internal engineering products.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure or similar cloud technologies.

* Familiarity with data governance, privacy compliance, GDPR, or regulatory platforms.

* Understanding of data discovery, classification, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.

* Experience with security, identity, access management, and role-based access control.

* Experience developing AI-powered product capabilities or workflow automation.

* Experience working with geographically distributed engineering and product teams.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

title: Senior Product Manager - Life Insurance & Annuity
job_description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

The Senior Product Manager leads the Product Life Cycle and strongly contributes to the research & development activities related to the design and development of our products and qualification or re-qualification of new and existing products. The individual will work with Zinnia's Product Organization to ensure alignment with organization's strategy and vision.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead & contribute into the execution of product lifecycle processes for our Insurtech products/platforms, work with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfilment of product requirements, evaluates product performance and transition products from development to commercialization.
* Lead technical discussions with Engineering teams & thoroughly manage technical/business requirements.
* Assists in determining product delivery and deployment dates for new product releases, feature and maintenance releases and regular corrective service or service pack releases.
* Mentor a lean team of Product Managers while acting as a technical consultant to the product organization and leads research and prototyping of innovative technologies and products.
* Ensures the technology and architectural roadmap of engineering is properly aligned with and supports the product/business road map
* Acts as a customer liaison on technical issues related to product integration, custom development and requirements.
* May lead major releases and ensure feature enhancements respond to customer requests.
* Responsible for product delivery managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* **9+ years of experience into Product Management, including analyzing software/product design, development, and deployment.**
* **Domain expertise in US Life Insurance & Annuity.**
* Bachelor's/Master's or equivalent Degree in technology or related field
* **Strong Background of working as a Technical & Functional Product Manager or Business Analyst/Product Analyst in an enterprise environment.**
* **Hands-on understanding of API Integration, SQL, Data Analysis etc.**
* **Strong understanding of SDLC & technology system interfaces, data integration.**
* An SME who performs work with a high degree of latitude; handles the most complex issues.
* Possess strong Communication skills, Problem-solving & Analytical thinking skills.
* Can lead individual assignments & deliver with strong expertise
* Expert level experience in delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and the use of relevant tools
* Ability to influence, lead, and work as part of a cross-functional in a global team setup

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, profit sharing, PF, incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Your Job**

As an **Associate Product Manager**, you will help grow the cable assembly business by managing existing business and advancing new Emerging and Focused Customer opportunities through product development and production launch. You will connect commercial, technical, and operational teams to develop profitable solutions, successfully launch programs, and drive long-term customer and business value.

**Our Team**

You will be part of the **CCS PSBU Product Management** team in Bangalore, working closely with Sales, Business Development, Engineering, Costing, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations. The team collaborates across functions to develop and launch profitable cable assembly solutions for customers.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Drive revenue, profitability, and market-share growth for the Emerging and Focused Customer cable assembly business.
* Manage new cable assembly opportunities through the middle and later stages of the product development process, from requirements validation and costing through qualification, production readiness, and launch.
* Lead costing, quotation, and profitable pricing activities while ensuring customer requirements, Bill of Materials (BOM), feasibility inputs, and commercial assumptions are complete and aligned.
* Develop and drive program plans covering scope, schedules, risks, milestones, and success criteria, and lead cross-functional teams in resolving barriers to execution.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations to ensure manufacturing readiness and smooth production ramp-up.
* Build strong relationships with customers, Sales, and distribution partners while serving as a key interface for technical and commercial discussions.
* Drive profitability of existing business through cost-variance improvements, capacity planning, quality improvements, and targeted cost-reduction opportunities.
* Monitor program performance, customer commitments, opportunity conversion, and product-development milestones, ensuring accurate records and effective stakeholder communication.

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
* **10+ years of experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Product Management within the electromechanical device industry.**
* Experience supporting **product costing, quotation, pricing, or commercial activities** for engineered products.
* Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, engineering, and manufacturing/operations teams.
* Fluent written and spoken English with proficiency in word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation applications.

  
**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience in the **cable assembly, connector, or interconnect industry**.
* Experience managing products or customer programs through **product development and production-launch lifecycles**.
* Experience with **SAP** or similar enterprise resource planning systems.
* Experience engaging customers and Sales teams in technical discussions related to cable assemblies.
* Demonstrated experience with cost reduction, profitability improvement, capacity planning, or manufacturing-readiness initiatives.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**PLEASE UPDATE JOB DESCRIPTION TO REFLECT ASSOCIATE PM**  
  
**Position Summary**

  

**Assist in shaping the individual product requirements in support of an existing product strategy. Accountable for assisting in driving the full product lifecycle from ideation to end-to-end of life. Responsible for relevant, specific product feature requirements. Ensuring that user personas & product requirements are defined and reflected in user stories. Working with the Scrum team on backlog grooming. Prioritising and Managing dependencies.**

  

**Supervision and Autonomy**

* **Conducts tasks & assignments as directed.**
* **Operates with moderate supervision, little instruction on routine work; detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. Latitude for independent judgment for defined tasks.**
* **Uses existing procedures to complete diverse assignments**

  

**Product Knowledge**

* **Develops competence by completing structured work assignments**
* **Expands knowledge about industry, customers, org. to capture internal/external requirements.**

  

**Position Responsibilities & Essential function**

* **Assist in shaping the individual product requirements in support of an existing product strategy.**
* **Accountable for assisting in driving the full product lifecycle from ideation to end-to-end of life. Responsible for relevant, specific product feature requirements. Limited interaction with net new products.**
* **Ensures that user personas & product requirements are defined and reflected in user stories. May also own and/or assist in Epic development.**
* **Works with the Scrum team on backlog grooming and ensures timely decision making on product requirement trade-offs.**
* **Translates defined product vision & Features (Epics) into user stories (based on feedback from dealers/customers & analysis of user & buyer personas) to deliver differentiated customer outcomes.**
* **Manages the backlog for scrum teams, partnering with R&D/scrum master to prioritise and plan product backlog, supporting full lifecycle from definition, beta, showcase, & retrospective.**
* **Works with other CDK product managers and product marketing to articulate the value proposition for user stories & Features (Epics). Owns dependency management.**
* **Understands the key product success metrics (e.g. adoption, profitability, NPS, market share growth) & how they relate to user stories/Features (Epics).**
* **Invests in gaining functional expertise & SME through training, partnering with more experienced CDK product managers.**
* **Develops & prioritizes user stories based on user/market requirements, strategy & business plan.**

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Preferred:**

* **Knowledge of Payments is preferred**

  

**Education/Experience**

* **Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience**
* **5+ years of Product Management and/or equivalent experience in Enterprise SaaS, full lifecycle management.**
* **Experience in Agile software/DevOps methodologies & working with globally distributed teams.**
* **Experience in creating user stories, working with R&D & other product managers to drive end-to-end execution of product releases.**
* **Strong written & verbal communication skills. Experience is facilitating customer communications.**
* **Ability to listen & consider the points of view of others, collaborate & build consensus with cross-functional areas.**
* **Strong technical aptitude, can work with R&D to translate business requirements into actionable user stories.**
* **Strong track record of product execution in dynamic environment.**

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)**

At CDK, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential in inspiring meaningful connections among our people. We foster an open and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, enabling everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and make a meaningful impact.

CDK is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with fairness, dignity, and respect. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, caste, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, nationality, ethnic origin, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

**Non-Discrimination and Reasonable Accommodation**

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of their role satisfactorily. CDK is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or other protected needs in accordance with applicable laws, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on the organization. CDK retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position as needed.

job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Analyzes, researches, develops and monitors new and existing products and services. Conducts comprehensive market research and strategic analysis. Provides market intelligence on industry issues shaping current and future business strategies and initiatives. Gathers technical specifications so that the product can be developed. -Applies a theoretical knowledge-base to work to achieves goals through own work -Characterized by specific functional expertise typically gained through formal education -May provide guidance to others as a project manager using technical expertise -Requires in-depth knowledge and experience -Uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services -Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions -Works independently, receives minimal guidance -Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience Functional Knowledge: -Requires understanding and application of procedures and concepts within own discipline and basic knowledge of other disciplines Business Expertise: -Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market Leadership: -Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements Problem Solving: -Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information Impact: -Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies Interpersonal Skills: -Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
